purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 811 Veracruz (city code 6604); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: H. Ayuntamiento de Veracruz; Dirección de Planeación Catastral
registryBasis: The official Ayuntamiento de Veracruz portal identifies a municipal Dirección de Planeación Catastral and a city cadastral-registration procedure for urban, suburban and rural property. It requires applicant identity, proof of title, sketch/coordinates and municipal payment; this verifies the local cadastral service but is not a public anonymous geometry route.

officialSources.observation: Official city procedure page names Dirección de Planeación Catastral and specifies a paid cadastral document process for urban/suburban/rural property, requiring applicant identity, title evidence, location plan/coordinates and payment. No form was completed.
Official state finance service describes paid retrieval of cadastral block plans from its archive; it does not expose anonymous vector features.
State cadastral law outlines municipal/state cadastral cartography and cadastral registration responsibilities; not used as a geometry source.
